# Replay inputs

These are synthetic scanner outputs for Semgrep 1.146.0, Gitleaks 8.24.2, Trivy 0.76.1, SonarScanner CLI 7.2.0.5079 and the SonarQube Community Build Web API. The scripts emulate command-line reports, subprocess exit codes, network status codes and task metadata. The live macOS samples in `docs/samples/` contain normalized results from the installed scanners. The test report records whether each check ran against installed scanners, replayed data, or is awaiting the owner.
